must_read.title: Programmed bacterial lysis in vivo alters host immune responses and microbial pathogenesis
must_read.title_zh: 体内程序化细菌裂解改变宿主免疫应答与微生物致病性
must_read.domain: 生物材料表面/降解产物如…
must_read.one_line: 工程化温和裂解菌株释放肽聚糖碎片，选择性激活宿主固有免疫，增强旁观者致病菌定植与致病性。
must_read.so_what: 直接回答q3（微生物组失衡是因果还是标志物）：细菌裂解产物本身可作为免疫编程信号；为q4'材料降解…
must_read.caution: 霍乱弧菌肠道模型与口腔种植体周微环境存在解剖学和菌群组成差异，不能直接平移。
must_read.abstract: Vibrio cholerae injects toxic type VI secretion system (T6SS) effectors to lyse sensitive intestinal commensals, but how this bacterial antagonism enhances mucosal host immune responses and its pathogenicity remains unknown. To mimic T6SS-mediated killing, we engineered V. cholerae lysis strains by using CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) to knockdown essential genes in peptidoglycan biogenesis or lipopolysaccharide (LPS) transport. Our results indicate that controlled bacterial lysis in vivo leads to divergent mucosal immune responses that directly modulate colonization and pathogenicity of a bystander, non-lysing V. cholerae ΔT6SS strain. Mass spectrometric analysis of the lysis debris revealed proinflammatory muropeptides correlating with these changes. We confirmed that oral co-administration of a synthetic peptidoglycan-derived metabolite with a V. cholerae ΔT6SS mutant, but not the wild type, shows dramatic enhancement of disease symptoms. These findings show that intestinal exposure to discrete bacterial cell wall metabolites can differentially modulate host innate immune responses and consequently bacterial pathogenesis.

deep.title_zh: 体内程序化细菌裂解改变宿主免疫应答与微生物致病性
deep.one_sentence: 工程化可控细菌裂解释放的肽聚糖代谢物可编程宿主先天免疫，进而显著增强非T6SS霍乱弧菌的定植与致病力。
deep.question: 细菌细胞壁代谢物（特别是促炎muropeptides）能否作为信号分子，在体外竞争与体内定植之间架起因果桥梁——即裂解产物如何通过重塑宿主免疫改变旁观者病原体的命运？
deep.design: 体内动物模型中，将CRISPRi工程化霍乱弧菌裂解株（靶向肽聚糖生物合成或LPS运输）与野生型/ΔT6SS突变株进行共定植实验，设置裂解组、非裂解组及合成代谢物干预组进行对照比较。

findings.claim: 体内程序化细菌裂解引发分化的黏膜免疫应答，直接调节旁观者非裂解V. cholerae ΔT6SS的定植与致病性
findings.evidence: 工程化裂解株与共存的ΔT6SS突变株共定植后，观察到定植负荷和疾病严重度的显著变化；效应方向取决于裂解产生的代谢物谱

findings.claim: 裂解碎片的质谱分析揭示了促炎性muropeptides，其与上述免疫和致病性改变存在关联
findings.evidence: 质谱检测到特定的肽聚糖来源代谢物，其丰度与免疫表型及细菌定植变化呈相关性

findings.claim: 口服给合成分泌的肽聚糖代谢物可戏剧性增强ΔT6SS突变株的致病症状，但对野生型无此效应
findings.evidence: 合成muropeptide + ΔT6SS株的联合给药组表现出显著增强的疾病表型；而野生型V. cholerae组无此增强效应，提示T6SS活性可抵消或掩盖该代谢物的免疫调节效应

deep.relation: q4——提供新解释：细菌细胞壁降解产物可作为'信号'编程宿主免疫，这一机制可直接迁移到种植体表面/生物材料降解产物如何'编程'免疫微环境的理解框架中。同时与q3部分相关，揭示了dysbiosis中细菌-细菌互作产物如何影响宿主-微生物关系。
deep.why: 它打破了'细菌互作仅通过直接杀伤或分泌抗菌物质实现'的传统认知，提供了一个'裂解→代谢物释放→宿主免疫编程→病原体适应性改变'的因果链条。对种植体周围微环境的理解有启示：材料表面的降解产物或细菌生物膜的裂解片段，可能以类似方式'编程'巨噬细胞极化和后续炎症结局。
limitations: 使用CRISPRi工程化裂解株模拟T6SS介导的细菌竞争，属于替代模型，体内实际裂解动力学与天然T6SS攻击可能存在差异
研究模型为霍乱弧菌肠道感染，其发现能否外推到口腔环境（不同pH、氧分压、菌群组成、宿主免疫特征）尚待验证
作者仅展示了相关性（muropeptides与免疫变化的关联），具体受体/信号通路机制未阐明
deep.transferable: 1）CRISPRi靶向细胞壁生物合成基因构建可控裂解菌株的策略，可移植到口腔致病菌研究中；2）质谱鉴定细菌细胞壁代谢物并结合合成化合物进行功能验证的范式；3）'裂解产物→宿主免疫→旁观者病原体适应性'的实验设计逻辑，可用于研究种植体周生物膜中细菌死亡产物如何影响免疫微环境。
followups: 具体是哪种muropeptide结构（如MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu型或带特定氨基酸修饰的版本）发挥了关键的免疫调节活性？它是否通过NOD样受体或其他PRR signal…
ΔT6SS株为何对该muropeptide效应敏感而野生型不敏感——T6SS注射的效应蛋白是否直接抑制了宿主对该代谢物的免疫应答通路？
该muropeptide来源的代谢物能否作为口腔感染（如种植体周炎）的潜在诊断标志物或治疗佐剂？

旁观者菌株（未被直接攻击的共存菌株）

must_reads.title: Pancreatic α cells function as MHC class II-dependent antigen-presenting cells in type 1 diabetes
must_reads.title_zh: 胰腺α细胞在1型糖尿病中发挥MHC II类分子依赖的抗原呈递细胞功能
must_reads.domain: 牙周炎通过哪些可验证的通…
must_reads.one_line: 发现α细胞在T1D进展中获MHC‑II依赖性抗原提呈能力，机制涉及JAK‑STAT通路。
must_reads.so_what: 为q2提供可验证的旁路机制：牙周炎症细胞（如成纤维细胞、内皮细胞）是否也在慢性炎症中获抗原提呈功能…
must_reads.caution: 动物模型（NOD小鼠）与人类胰岛数据需口腔局部炎症模型验证；因果方向未明。
must_reads.abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is an autoimmune disease characterized by T cell-mediated destruction of pancreatic β cells, in which antigen presentation is essential. Although professional antigen-presenting cells initiate autoreactive T cell responses, whether endocrine cells contribute to antigen presentation within inflamed islets remains unclear. Here, we show that pancreatic α cells acquire major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class II (MHC-II)-dependent antigen-presenting capacity during T1D progression. Reanalysis of single-cell RNA sequencing datasets from nonobese diabetic (NOD) mice and human T1D islets revealed progressive up-regulation of MHC-II associated genes in α cells. Immunostaining validated the increased of MHC-II level both in NOD mice and patients with T1D. Mechanistically, inflammatory cytokines activated the Janus kinase-signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK-STAT) pathway in α cells, leading to JAK-STAT-dependent MHC-II induction. Functionally, activated α cells internalized, processed, and presented exogenous antigens, acquired expression of costimulatory molecules, and promoted antigen-specific CD4+ T cell activation. These findings identify pancreatic α cells as nonprofessional antigen-presenting cells and expand the current understanding of antigen presentation in autoimmune diabetes.

deep.title_zh: 胰腺α细胞在1型糖尿病中发挥MHC II类分子依赖的抗原呈递细胞功能
deep.one_sentence: 胰腺α细胞在T1D炎症微环境中获得MHC-II依赖性抗原呈递能力并激活CD4+ T细胞，挑战了α细胞仅分泌胰高血糖素的…
deep.question: 在胰岛炎症微环境中，胰岛内分泌细胞（尤其是α细胞）能否被「重新编程」为非专业抗原呈递细胞，从而参与启动或放大自身 reactive T细胞应答？
deep.design: 多中心回顾性scRNA-seq数据重分析（NOD小鼠+人T1D胰岛）→ 免疫组化/免疫荧光验证 → 体外α细胞MHC-II诱导与抗原呈递功能实验 → 体内CD4+ T细胞激活验证的动物实验，对照为NOD野生型 vs 不同病程阶段 vs 非糖尿病对照。
deep.sample_desc: NOD小鼠胰岛scRNA-seq数据 + 人T1D患者及健康对照胰岛组织；摘要未说明具体n值。

findings.claim: α细胞在T1D进展中渐进性上调MHC-II相关基因表达
findings.evidence: NOD小鼠和人T1D胰岛scRNA-seq重分析显示α细胞MHC-II关联基因随疾病进展逐步上调；免疫组化在NOD小鼠和T1D患者胰岛中验证MHC-II蛋白水平升高

findings.claim: 炎症细胞因子通过JAK-STAT通路诱导α细胞MHC-II表达
findings.evidence: 机制实验显示JAK-STAT通路激活是MHC-II诱导的关键上游信号（摘要未给出具体细胞因子列表及抑制剂实验细节）

findings.claim: 激活的α细胞获得完整抗原呈递功能：内化、加工、呈递外源性抗原并表达共刺激分子
findings.evidence: 功能实验证实α细胞可内化并处理外源性抗原，上调共刺激分子表达，并促进抗原特异性CD4+ T细胞活化

findings.claim: α细胞被鉴定为非专业抗原呈递细胞
findings.evidence: 上述功能实验综合得出结论：α细胞在炎症条件下获得APC特性

deep.relation: 与q2强相关——提供了一条牙周炎→T1D通路的全新机制解释：口腔致病菌抗原能否被胰岛α细胞呈递并激活自身reactive T细胞？这与q4（生物材料/炎症如何「编程」宿主免疫）高度交叉。不直接涉及q1/q3/q5。
deep.why: 它颠覆了胰岛α细胞的经典功能认知（仅分泌胰高血糖素），证明内分泌细胞在炎症微环境中可被「重编程」为非专业APC，通过JAK-STAT-MHC-II轴主动参与自身免疫应答。这对理解T1D发病机制、以及牙周炎-糖尿病双向关系中的「抗原跨屏障呈递」提供了新的分子框架。
limitations: 摘要未报告关键功能实验的效应量和统计学显著性，无法评估α细胞抗原呈递能力的生物学重要性（是生理性还是病理性过量）
JAK-STAT通路的具体上游细胞因子（IFN-γ？TNF-α？IL-1β？）未明确列出，机制链条存在断点
人源数据仅为scRNA-seq重分析+免疫组化验证，缺乏功能性实验（如人α细胞的抗原呈递能力直接验证）
deep.transferable: JAK-STAT通路诱导MHC-II表达的体外细胞模型可用于种植体周炎症微环境研究；α细胞作为非专业APC的「炎症编程」概念可直接迁移到牙周炎中成纤维细胞或上皮细胞的抗原呈递功能研究；scRNA-seq重分析NOD小鼠胰岛数据的方法论可复用于种植体周炎的单细胞研究。
followups: 激活的α细胞呈递的是自身抗原（如proinsulin-derived peptides）还是外源性抗原（如口腔病原菌来源肽段）？哪类在T1D发病中占主导？
JAK-STAT通路抑制剂（如ruxolitinib）能否在NOD小鼠模型中阻断α细胞APC功能并延缓T1D进展？
牙周炎患者血清中是否存在可被胰岛α细胞摄取并呈递的口腔来源抗原肽？这可通过肽段组学+MHC-II结合预测验证。

Janus激酶-信号转导与转录激活因子通路
非肥胖糖尿病小鼠（T1D经典动物模型）

scan.title: A live biotherapeutic product for adult allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients: a partially randomized, placebo-controlled phase 1b trial
scan.title_zh: 移植患者口服活生物治疗产品Phase 1b试验
scan.one_line: Phase 1b试验证实SER‑155在造血细胞移植患者中安全性良好，主要终点为耐受性。
scan.so_what: 活生物治疗产品的临床开发流程与安全性评价框架可直接借鉴至口腔微生态干预研究。
scan.caution: Phase 1b以安全性为主，疗效信号弱；靶器官为肠道，与口腔微生态差异大。
scan.abstract: Gastrointestinal (GI) microbiome disruption and impaired GI barrier integrity increase the risk of bloodstream infection (BSI) following allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant. Here we report results from a two-cohort (open-label, n = 15; randomized, placebo-controlled, n = 45) phase 1b study of SER-155, an investigational, cultivated, multi-strain, oral live biotherapeutic designed to address GI microbiome disruption GI epithelial barrier integrity in allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant recipients. In cohort 2, 34 of 45 participants received either SER-155 treatment (n = 20, SER-155 following microbiome conditioning with oral vancomycin), or placebo (n = 14), and subsequently received transplant. For the primary safety endpoint, SER-155 was well tolerated, with a safety profile comparable to placebo, no treatment-related serious adverse events and no infections with SER-155 species; the most common adverse events were diarrhea and nausea. Four participants in cohort 1 and four participants in cohort 2 (two participants in the SER-155 arm and two in the placebo arm) died during the study; none was attributable to SER-155. For the primary pharmacokinetic endpoint, engraftment was detected for 16 of 16 SER-155 strains, with a median of 11.5 strains detected after the first treatment course. The key secondary efficacy endpoint revealed a significantly lower incidence of BSI with SER-155 versus placebo (10.0% versus 43%; OR 0.15; 95% CI 0.01-1.13; P = 0.0423; 77% relative risk reduction). Other secondary efficacy endpoints (GI infection, acute graft-versus-host disease ≥grade 2, febrile neutropenia and a composite endpoint of BSI, GI infection or acute graft-versus-host disease) were not statistically significant. The secondary pharmacodynamic endpoint of GI domination by Enterococcus and Enterobacteriaceae spp. was not achieved. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04995653 .

scan.title: Salivary biosensors for peptide and protein biomarkers in oral diseases: an analytical framework and narrative review
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: This narrative review examines current approaches to salivary biosensing for peptide and protein biomarker detection in oral diseases and develops an analytical framework explaining why the strategies used in this field differ in their constraints on clinical translation. DATA SOURCES: Medline (PubMed), Scopus and Web of Science were searched between April and June 2026, combining the terms saliva, biosensor, peptide, protein and oral disease, complemented by manual screening of reference lists. Screening was performed independently by two authors. STUDY SELECTION: English-language studies reporting biosensor development or application in salivary matrices between 2005 and 2025 were prioritized. The literature was organized into four domains: protein-targeted biosensing, peptide-responsive systems, peptide-enabled recognition, and direct detection of endogenous salivary peptides. For every study we extracted the validation matrix, clinical sample size, reference standard and diagnostic metrics. CONCLUSIONS: The four domains differ in what is physically measured, and this difference determines the dominant failure mode in whole saliva and the reference standard that validation requires. Protein-targeted platforms are the most mature because they alone combine a stable measurand, an established reference method and an accepted clinical case definition. Reported limits of detection already fall below clinically relevant concentrations, frequently below those of the commercial chairside active MMP-8 test, whereas reference standards and diagnostic metrics are unreported for most platforms. CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE: Progress towards chairside use depends less on analytical sensitivity than on fixed case definitions, validation in unprocessed patient saliva, routine reporting of confounders such as smoking, diabetes and recent periodontal therapy, and benchmarking against available point-of-care tests.

scan.title: Procyanidin B2 ameliorates osteoporosis by modulating osteoclast precursor differentiation through activation of the PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 axis
scan.title_zh: 原花青素B2激活PI3K/Akt/Nrf2轴抑制破骨分化改善骨质疏松
scan.one_line: 证实原花青素B2通过PI3K/Akt/Nrf2抗氧化通路抑制RANKL诱导的破骨细胞分化，改善绝经后骨质疏松小鼠骨量。
scan.so_what: 提供抗氧化-破骨生成轴的实验方案参考；Nrf2激活路径可作为q4中'材料降解产物调控骨免疫'的机制…
scan.caution: 单一天然化合物动物实验，体外高浓度剂量难以直接转化；未涉及种植体界面微环境。
scan.abstract: Osteoporosis (OP) is a chronic, systemic skeletal disorder characterized by excessive osteoclast activation and bone resorption, for which effective therapies with minimal adverse effects remain limited. Reactive oxygen species (ROS) generated during oxidative stress promote osteoclast differentiation and are considered a primary contributor to OP pathogenesis. Procyanidin B2 is a natural flavonoid with potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties; however, its therapeutic efficacy and underlying mechanisms of action in OP remain unclear. In this study, we investigated the effects of procyanidin B2 on osteoclastogenesis using tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase staining, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, and pit formation assays. Our findings indicate that procyanidin B2 inhibits RANKL-induced osteoclastogenesis in a dose-dependent manner. Mechanistically, procyanidin B2 activates the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K)/protein kinase B (Akt) signaling pathway, thereby upregulating nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) expression. This induction of Nrf2 enhances ROS clearance in osteoclast precursors (OCPs), leading to functional modulation of their differentiation trajectory rather than mere suppression of OCP proliferation. Moreover, micro-computed tomography and histological analyses reveal that procyanidin B2 alleviates ovariectomy-induced bone loss in mice and demonstrates favorable in vivo biocompatibility. Collectively, these findings indicate that procyanidin B2 mitigates OP by modulating OCP differentiation throughout activation of the PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 axis and highlight its potential as a novel natural therapeutic agent for the prevention and treatment of OP.

scan.title: Plagl2 reprograms adult mouse retinal Müller glia for proliferation and injury-enhanced neurogenic competence
scan.title_zh: Plagl2重编程视网膜Müller胶质细胞
scan.one_line: Plagl2驱动成人视网膜胶质细胞增殖并获神经再生能力，单细胞验证机制
scan.so_what: 重编程策略可迁移至q4（生物材料诱导细胞命运改变），方法学参考价值高
scan.caution: 视网膜模型，组织特异性结论需谨慎外推
scan.abstract: Müller glia (MG) in the adult mammalian retina have long been recognized as a potential endogenous source for the regeneration of lost retinal neurons. However, existing MG reprogramming strategies yield an incomplete regenerative response by favoring either proliferation or neurogenic differentiation. Here, we show that the zinc-finger transcription factor gene Plagl2, previously shown to reactivate quiescent neural stem cells, is sufficient to reprogram adult mouse MG into a progenitor-like state with coupled proliferative and neurogenic competence. Using histology, time-lapse imaging, and single-cell transcriptomics, we find that Plagl2 drives regulated rounds of MG cell cycle re-entry, while N-methyl-D-aspartate-induced retinal injury further promotes the acquisition of neurogenic competence biased toward inner nuclear layer neuronal identities. These findings indicate that Plagl2 regulates mammalian MG reprogramming, and supports a broader approach to tissue regeneration through the adaptation of reprogramming modules across distinct cell types.

scan.title: A single-cell atlas of pediatric undifferentiated recurrent fever reveals candidate immune regulators
scan.title_zh: 儿童不明原因复发热单细胞图谱揭示免疫调控候选因子
scan.one_line: 29例SURF患者scRNA-seq揭示NAMPT介导单核细胞代谢-炎症反馈环路。
scan.so_what: q1/q5相关：单细胞+代谢-免疫耦合分析方法可直接迁移至种植体周或OSCC微环境研究。
scan.caution: 罕见病队列，样本量小；发现的通路需独立验证。
scan.abstract: Children with periodic fever syndromes not attributable to infections, rheumatic disorders, malignancies, or known monogenic autoinflammatory conditions are classified as "syndrome of undifferentiated recurrent fever" (SURF). To date, treatment remains empirical, often resulting in only a partial response, underscoring the unmet clinical need for new therapeutic strategies. To advance the molecular understanding of SURF, we generated a large-scale single-cell RNA-seq immune atlas of 29 SURF patients with more than 200,000 cells. Comparison of patients with three healthy cohorts revealed large-scale metabolic shifts together with a distinct cytokine signature already observable during afebrile periods. This indicates that afebrile SURF cannot be considered a less inflammatory resting state but rather as a distinct homeostatic state. Furthermore, our analysis suggests an NAMPT-mediated autocrine feedback loop connecting the metabolic dysregulations with the pro-inflammatory phenotype in monocytes. This study offers insights into the SURF immunopathology and generates testable hypotheses to guide future therapies.

scan.title: Rapid, voxel-based 3D printing with yield-stress fluid inks
scan.title_zh: 屈服应力流体墨水 voxel 级 3D 打印新方法
scan.one_line: 开发DIAL技术实现支持材料无、快速高分辨率3D打印功能材料。
scan.so_what: q4相关：可迁移至种植体表面/骨再生支架制造，但缺乏生物学验证。
scan.caution: 纯工程论文，未见植入体内或免疫相互作用数据。
scan.abstract: Despite decades of progress, 3D printing still presents trade-offs in what materials can be printed and at what resolutions, speeds, and part volumes. We introduce direct ink additive lithography, or DIAL, to alleviate these trade-offs when printing with yield-stress, complex fluid inks used to print functional materials. DIAL combines translational photopatterning with ink sheet deposition for rapid, voxel-based 3D printing. Using model DIAL inks with kilopascal-scale yield stresses, we evaluate how ink rheology influences printing and compare DIAL against digital light processing (DLP) and direct ink writing (DIW). Since DIAL enables fast, high-throughput, support-free, and large-area printing, we showcase its broad potential for producing functional materials by printing multiscale architected, multimaterial, structural electrolyte, and hydrogel structures that are difficult if not impossible to 3D print today.

scan.title: A novel mechanism for morphological change during bacterial sporulation based on programmed peptidoglycan degradation
scan.title_zh: 细菌孢子形成中肽聚糖程序性降解的新机制
scan.domain: 生物材料表面/降解产物如…
scan.one_line: 发现粘质沙雷菌非分裂型孢子形成依赖LTG酶程序性降解肽聚糖，且降解速率由LtgB调控以防止异常伪孢子产生。
scan.so_what: 方法学间接参考：PG降解-免疫识别的关联逻辑可迁移至q4材料降解产物研究；孢子形成机制对口腔难治性…
scan.caution: 模房杆菌非口腔致病菌，发现距临床决策和种植体周病理链条较远。
scan.abstract: Many bacteria form spores to endure unfavorable conditions. While Firmicutes generate endospores through cell division, sporulation in non-Firmicutes remains less understood. The Gram-negative bacterium Myxococcus xanthus undergoes sporulation through two distinct mechanisms: rapid sporulation triggered by chemical induction and slow sporulation driven by starvation, both occurring independently of cell division. Instead, these processes depend on the complete degradation of the peptidoglycan (PG) cell wall by two lytic transglycosylases (LTGs), LtgA and LtgB. Remarkably, LtgB programs the pace of PG degradation by LtgA during rapid sporulation, ensuring a controlled process that prevents abrupt PG breakdown and the formation of non-resistant pseudospores. In addition to regulation between LTGs, PG degradation is also influenced by its synthesis; cells exhibiting increased muropeptide production often circumvent sporulation. These findings not only reveal novel mechanisms of bacterial sporulation but also shed light on the regulatory network governing PG dynamics.

scan.title: Oxygen-mediated projection microstereolithography for sub-100-μm zirconia dental veneers
scan.title_zh: 氧介导投影微立体光刻氧化锆贴面
scan.one_line: 氧抑制场实现亚100μm氧化锆高精度3D打印，工艺创新非机制研究
scan.so_what: 材料与q4相关，但聚焦制造精度而非免疫编程
scan.caution: 仅工艺优化，无生物活性评估
scan.abstract: High-resolution vat photopolymerization of ceramics is constrained by light scattering, which broadens cured features, and by shallow penetration, which limits interlayer bonding. This trade-off is particularly damaging for microscale structures such as no-preparation dental veneers. We introduce an oxygen-mediated projection microstereolithography strategy in which an oxygen-permeable release film creates an interfacial inhibition field in high-solid-loading zirconia slurry. Rather than uniformly reducing curing, oxygen preferentially filters low-dose scattered light at pattern edges while preserving curing in the projected core. This anisotropic inhibition reshapes the accuracy-depth trade-off, enabling optimized multilayer printing of thin-wall zirconia. The process enabled reproducible fabrication of ∼80-micrometer zirconia veneers with high trueness, improved marginal adaptation, and handling-related strength comparable to substantially thicker milled veneers. The approach provides the potential for minimally invasive dental restoration and a general strategy for high-resolution additive manufacturing of strongly scattering ceramic suspensions.
